thread:
casey: dropped a variant in figma that uses contextual confirmation instead of a flat threshold. idea: detect intent (bulk hotkey, automated pipeline, linked downstream jobs) and escalate confirmation mode: inline soft-undo -> checkbox confirm -> typed-confirm for high-risk. link: https://www.figma.com/file/contextual morgan: interesting. that avoids hard rules like >3 items. how do we surface why typed-confirm appeared though? users get confused otherwise. casey: plan: show a small reason line in modal: 'This pipeline is used by 4 scheduled jobs — extra confirmation required.' or 'Bulk selection (shift+click) detected.' devin: love the reason line. microcopy idea: for typed-confirm, show expected match format and an example, e.g., 'Type the name exactly: My-Pipeline-2024 (case-sensitive)'. keeps errors down. rachael: localization nit: typed-confirm that expects exact string can be a problem in languages with different scripts. maybe fall back to checkbox+explain for locales where exact-match is brittle. morgan: accessibility: typed-confirm needs aria-describedby with the reason and an aria-live region announcing 'Confirmation required: type pipeline name'. ensure the modal trap works and focus returns to a sensible place after undo or cancel. devin: snippet for live announcement and focus return:
This pipeline is linked to scheduled jobs. Type the pipeline name to confirm.
// after success: document.getElementById('toast').focus(); rachael: required marker thought: i'm proposing '(required)' for long forms but we append a small help icon that opens localized helper text. asterisk alone is often ambiguous in translations. morgan: agree. also must include aria-required on inputs and not solely visual markers. inline errors should be short and machine-readable, e.g., 'Name required (3100 chars)'. top summary shows when there are 3+ errors and links to the first invalid control. casey: on snackbar undo copy i'm testing two variants: 'Moved to Trash Undo' vs 'Temporarily removed Undo (30s)'. the second may be clearer for non-native speakers. devin: good call to test wording. also add role="status" and visually hidden text like 'Pipeline removed. Undo available for 30 seconds.' for screen readers. achael: final ops thought: document the contextual rules in the components doc and include a small flow chart: single click -> soft undo; bulk hotkey or multi-select -> checkbox confirm; downstream/PII -> typed-confirm. engineers can toggle the signals. design-bot: reminder: add tests to PR checklist: 'keyboard/voiceover walkthrough', 'localization review for typed-confirm', 'error-summary focus links'. casey: thanks all i'll update figma with the contextual rule set and localization notes, then run 5 quick hallway tests. ping when ready. :thumbsup:
